dialogues.speaker: Miu
dialogues.text: Ohh, how could this have happened? Not only has the author Taiyaki's latest work been delayed by work, but "A Country From the Center of the Earth and a Bouquet for You" will also stop releasing temporarily!

dialogues.speaker: Miu
dialogues.text: But... But the two protagonists were just about to confess their feelings to each other at the end of the last volume!

dialogues.speaker: Miu
dialogues.text: You don't understand! In the original series that Taiyaki's fan novel was based on, the two protagonists could not resolve their differences and separated!

dialogues.speaker: Miu
dialogues.text: I've... I've pinned all my hopes for their happiness onto Taiyaki!

dialogues.speaker: Shiho
dialogues.text: Um, well, if you wish for their happiness that much, why don't you write them a happy ending?

dialogues.speaker: Miu
dialogues.text: Me? ...Well, actually, you've got a point. Be the change we want to see and everything, you know?
